prompt: Write a method that counts the non-overlapping occurrences of a substring. Complete the countOccurrences method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: indexOf(sub, from) finds the next match at or after position from, returning -1 when there are no more. Advancing the search position by sub.length() after each hit is what makes the count non-overlapping -- moving by only 1 would count overlapping matches instead. The empty-substring guard matters because indexOf("") returns 0 forever and would loop endlessly.
hints: s.indexOf(sub, from) searches starting at index from and returns -1 when sub is not found.
After each match at position found, continue the search at found + sub.length() so matches never overlap.
Handle the empty sub first: without that guard, indexOf("") matches at every position and the loop never ends.
